tpcdi-etl:duckdb:customer_mgmt: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE CustomerMgmtRaw AS WITH actions AS (SELECT UNNEST(XML_EXTRACT_ELEMENTS(xml, '//*[local-name()=''Action'']')) AS node FROM READ_XML_OBJECTS($customer_mgmt_path, maximum_file_size => 2000000000)), fields AS (SELECT XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '/*/@ActionType')[1] AS actiontype, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '/*/@ActionTS')[1] AS actionts, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Customer/@C_ID')[1] AS customerid, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Customer/@C_TAX_ID')[1] AS taxid, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Customer/@C_GNDR')[1] AS gender, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Customer/@C_TIER')[1] AS tier, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Customer/@C_DOB')[1] AS dob, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Account/@CA_ID')[1] AS accountid, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Account/@CA_TAX_ST')[1] AS taxstatus, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Account/CA_B_ID')[1] AS brokerid, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Account/CA_NAME')[1] AS accountdesc, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Name/C_L_NAME')[1] AS lastname, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Name/C_F_NAME')[1] AS firstname, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Name/C_M_NAME')[1] AS middleinitial, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Address/C_ADLINE1')[1] AS addressline1, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Address/C_ADLINE2')[1] AS addressline2, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Address/C_ZIPCODE')[1] AS postalcode, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Address/C_CITY')[1] AS city, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Address/C_STATE_PROV')[1] AS stateprov, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Address/C_CTRY')[1] AS country, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_1/C_CTRY_CODE')[1] AS phone1_ctry, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_1/C_AREA_CODE')[1] AS phone1_area, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_1/C_LOCAL')[1] AS phone1_local, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_1/C_EXT')[1] AS phone1_ext, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_2/C_CTRY_CODE')[1] AS phone2_ctry, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_2/C_AREA_CODE')[1] AS phone2_area, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_2/C_LOCAL')[1] AS phone2_local, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_2/C_EXT')[1] AS phone2_ext, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_3/C_CTRY_CODE')[1] AS phone3_ctry, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_3/C_AREA_CODE')[1] AS phone3_area, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_3/C_LOCAL')[1] AS phone3_local, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_3/C_EXT')[1] AS phone3_ext, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//ContactInfo/C_PRIM_EMAIL')[1] AS email1, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//ContactInfo/C_ALT_EMAIL')[1] AS email2, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//TaxInfo/C_LCL_TX_ID')[1] AS lcl_tx_id, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//TaxInfo/C_NAT_TX_ID')[1] AS nat_tx_id FROM actions) SELECT CAST(NULLIF(customerid, '') AS BIGINT) AS customerid, CAST(NULLIF(accountid, '') AS BIGINT) AS accountid, CAST(NULLIF(brokerid, '') AS BIGINT) AS brokerid, NULLIF(taxid, '') AS taxid, NULLIF(accountdesc, '') AS accountdesc, CAST(NULLIF(taxstatus, '') AS SMALLINT) AS taxstatus, NULLIF(lastname, '') AS lastname, NULLIF(firstname, '') AS firstname, NULLIF(middleinitial, '') AS middleinitial, NULLIF(gender, '') AS gender, CAST(NULLIF(tier, '') AS SMALLINT) AS tier, CAST(NULLIF(dob, '') AS DATE) AS dob, NULLIF(addressline1, '') AS addressline1, NULLIF(addressline2, '') AS addressline2, NULLIF(postalcode, '') AS postalcode, NULLIF(city, '') AS city, NULLIF(stateprov, '') AS stateprov, NULLIF(country, '') AS country, CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone1_local, '') IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone1_ctry, '') IS NULL THEN '+' || phone1_ctry || ' ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone1_area, '') IS NULL THEN '(' || phone1_area || ') ' ELSE '' END, phone1_local, COALESCE(phone1_ext, '')) END AS phone1, CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone2_local, '') IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone2_ctry, '') IS NULL THEN '+' || phone2_ctry || ' ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone2_area, '') IS NULL THEN '(' || phone2_area || ') ' ELSE '' END, phone2_local, COALESCE(phone2_ext, '')) END AS phone2, CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone3_local, '') IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone3_ctry, '') IS NULL THEN '+' || phone3_ctry || ' ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone3_area, '') IS NULL THEN '(' || phone3_area || ') ' ELSE '' END, phone3_local, COALESCE(phone3_ext, '')) END AS phone3, NULLIF(email1, '') AS email1, NULLIF(email2, '') AS email2, NULLIF(lcl_tx_id, '') AS lcl_tx_id, NULLIF(nat_tx_id, '') AS nat_tx_id, CAST(NULLIF(actionts, '') AS TIMESTAMP) AS update_ts, actiontype FROM fields
